name: Ireland

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and orange from the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the Gaelic tradition, orange the supporters of William of Orange, and white the lasting peace between them.

hook: Ireland runs green-white-orange from the flagpole, green like its fields first; Ivory Coast reverses it to orange-white-green, and Italy uses red instead of orange.
trivia: Thomas Francis Meagher first unveiled the tricolour in 1848, inspired by the French flag.
It was flown over the General Post Office in Dublin during the Easter Rising of 1916.
